name: Costa Vida (Draper / Herriman / Orem / Logan) Grilled Chicken or Sweet Pork Bowl (Cilantro-Free Rice, No Beans/Lime)
brandOrRestaurant: Costa Vida Fresh Mexican Grill (Draper / Herriman / Orem / Logan, UT)
whyItWorks: Soft house-made flour tortillas, tender shredded sweet pork or grilled chicken, Monterey Jack cheese, and guacamole provide a comforting Utah Mexican meal when you skip whole black/pinto beans, raw lettuce, and salsa.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a Small Sweet Pork or Grilled Chicken Quesadilla or Burrito (baked "enchilada style" without sauce, or dry) with rice and Jack cheese ONLY—hold black/pinto beans, shredded lettuce, pico de gallo, and lime wedges.
watchOuts: Costa Vida rice and marinades contain a hint of lime juice (citrusFree: false)—if strictly flaring from trace citrus, order a plain Flour Tortilla & Jack Cheese Quesadilla with plain shredded chicken
